problems.explain: f(g(x)) is f with every x replaced by the whole of g(x), 2x + 1, in brackets: f(g(x)) = (2x + 1)² − (2x + 1) − 5. (2x + 1)² is (2x + 1)(2x + 1), not each term squared. Multiply out and collect: f(g(x)) = 4x² + 2x − 5.
